Nested attributed labels
===========================

i(x){if(x){case 1:[[a]]e:[[a]];;}e k;}

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (type_identifier)
    (parenthesized_declarator
      (identifier))
    (compound_statement
      (function_definition
        (type_identifier)
        (parenthesized_declarator
          (identifier))
        (compound_statement
          (case_statement
            (number_literal)
            (attributed_statement
              (attribute_declaration
                (attribute
                  (identifier)))
              (labeled_statement
                (statement_identifier)
                (attributed_statement
                  (attribute_declaration
                    (attribute
                      (identifier)))
                  (expression_statement))))
            (expression_statement))))
      (declaration
        (type_identifier)
        (identifier)))))
